description:
A simplified touch optimized interface for QGIS in the field.


What's Changed
- Fix project translation failure to match app locale when available
- Allow for folders to be deleted in non-folder view to clear up imported / created projects
- Fix for cloudify button and project creation interference between cloudify and clone/template
- Fix permission issue with files generated by the image sketcher
- Fix dashboard editing toggle switch padding by
- Add an object name to the identify tool item for plugins to access and customize
- Fix missing global/project/map settings expression context when rendering the map texture for the 3D map view
- Fix loss of location metadata when rotating / mirroring camera images
- Show upload progress on the upload button instead of the busy page
- Fix inverted lighting on 3D polygon fills and walls
- Insure that the add child feature actions within relation editors are only visible when the project configuration allows for it
- Apply eye of dome lighting effect on the terrain instead of the View3D to avoid rendering on top of geometry overlays
- Restore value relation search speed by bailing out of unaccented searches for large datasets
Full Changelog: v4.3.3...v4.3.4
